title: Clerk section heading
description: A small coloured eyebrow, a compact 32px semibold heading (or a 56px bold hero title), a muted paragraph and an optional caret link. Left-aligned or centred.
notes: fadeText fades the paragraph from foreground to muted across its width, as on the dark bands
name: clerk-heading

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small coloured label above the heading

props.name: eyebrowTone
props.description: primary: brand violet · highlight: the second accent (cyan on dark)

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; pass a list to choose where the lines break on wide screens

props.name: text
props.description: paragraph under the heading; a list makes several paragraphs

props.name: as
props.description: h1 for the page title, h2 for sections

props.name: fadeText
props.description: fades the paragraph from foreground to muted, left to right (the dark bands do this)

props.name: textClassName
props.description: extra classes for the paragraph (e.g. a max width)
